description: Encode English into Ubbi Dubbi (inserting 'ub' before every vowel sound) and decode it back.

faqs.a: 'Hello' becomes 'hubellubo' — 'ub' is inserted before every vowel (a, e, i, o, u).
faqs.q: How does Ubbi Dubbi encoding work?

faqs.a: Yes. Decoding removes each 'ub' that sits directly before a vowel, restoring the original text.
faqs.q: Can I decode Ubbi Dubbi back to English?

faqs.a: Words that already contain 'ub' before a consonant (like 'subway') are left alone by the decoder.
